origin: written 2026-11-28 for #748 (send re-dial after a server outage), and the regression test of the fix that came out of it: two 16 MiB cold sends start while the server is down, meet their receivers on the local network, and have that link cut for 6 s mid-transfer (net.partition) while the server is still down; the server returns at 40 s. Main 2d412ab53 failed 12/12 by O15 ('the receiver is unreachable ... did not come back within 45s', 37 to 52 s after the last heal): the LAN re-dial relinked the receiver under a new pid, which the established send kept as a responder while its stall ladder rebuilt the dead LAN pid. Reverting #748 also fails 12/12.
